components.purpose: Single component that covers the whole request: its Heading/Subheading fields provide the section heading, and its nested BentoCard grid provides the grid of cards — each card has a required 'Graphic' image (for the screenshot) and a required 'Description' (short description), plus Title/Eyebrow for a card label. Its own description explicitly calls it out as 'a great way to showcase some screenshots or graphics,' which matches the request better than FeatureGrid's small 'Icon' field.
